note: Gas-phase EC-MS signals digitized from SI figures. Inputs only: not a batch concentration trajectory; do not convert with scripts/digitized_to_dataset.py and do not copy to data/real.

files.extracted.csv: tidy long format, one row per trace per pixel column

csv_columns.time_min: time axis of the figure (minutes, figure's own origin)
csv_columns.species: assigned species, or the authors' label for a raw m/z channel; empty for current/potential
csv_columns.channel: plotted channel (m/z, deconvoluted channel, current density, potential)
csv_columns.value: column-median value of the plotted stroke
csv_columns.value_lo/value_hi: vertical extent of the stroke centre-line in that pixel column (wide on steep or noisy segments)
csv_columns.px_col: pixel column in the native embedded image
csv_columns.flags: per-point: multi_row_column (stroke spans > stroke+2 px: use lo/hi), clipped_at_panel_top (true value >= value_hi), touches_panel_bottom, split_stroke (JPEG gap in a steep segment); per-trace flags explained in quality_flags

units.m/z channels: pA (raw ion current, baseline handling as plotted by the authors; not converted to flux)

provenance.citation: Willoughby W. L., Hannagan R. T., Guo J., Benedek P., Yap K. M. K., Burke Stevens M., Nielander A. C., Tarpeh W. A., Jaramillo T. F., Dynamic Quantification of Nitrogen Species in Acidic Titanium-Catalyzed Nitrate Reduction toward Ammonia, ACS Electrochem. 2 (2026) 353. Supporting Information.
provenance.page: PDF p. 9 (SI p. S9); embedded image is JPEG

si_version.other_version: ec5c00405_si_001__1_.pdf (md5 0fb0d1662e45f89665c7abdf4c25c792): identical text and byte-identical embedded figure images; differs only by an ACS 'Downloaded from pubs.acs.org ... by guest on 20 October 2026' margin stamp on every page (x 588-593 pt, outside all figure areas) and PDF producer/ModDate metadata. The unstamped file was used.
si_version.main_text: not available (paywalled); only the SI was read

provenance.extraction_method: Raster digitization. Every SI figure is a single embedded raster (no vector paths, no text layer over the figure), so page.get_drawings() did not apply. Native embedded image extracted with pymupdf at ~200 dpi. Axes: linear least-squares fit of tick-mark pixel positions (located by scanning for dark tick runs off each axis line) to tick labels read visually from zoomed crops; label centres were used only where a tick is hidden (flagged). Trace: per pixel column, pixels within an RGB distance of the trace colour and above a saturation floor, legend line samples masked; value = calibrated median row of the stroke pixels; value_lo/value_hi = top/bottom of the stroke shrunk by half the stroke width (the vertical extent the plotted line covers in that column). One row per pixel column; no smoothing, interpolation or filling. Columns where the trace is hidden under another trace or off-scale are absent. Checked by redrawing the extracted values onto the original crop through the inverse calibration (overlay kept in scratch, not in the repo).
provenance.scripts: scratch only (team/willoughby/digitize.py, build.py, overlay_final.py); not in repo
provenance.verification: inverse-calibration overlay of every extracted point on the native figure crop, inspected visually per panel; tick-fit residuals listed under calibration

quality_flags.raster_digitized: no vector data in the SI; precision limited to ~0.25 px after calibration
quality_flags.gas_phase_rate_not_concentration: EC-MS gas-outlet signals; not liquid-phase concentrations; not for scripts/digitized_to_dataset.py
quality_flags.zero_floor_likely_clipped: off-period traces sit exactly on zero for long stretches (e.g. S1c H2 0-6 min); the authors' baseline-subtracted data appear floored at 0, so near-zero values are not informative
quality_flags.slightly_negative_at_zero: values within ~1 px of zero can be slightly negative from stroke width; left unclamped
quality_flags.raw_ion_current: not calibrated to flux; S1c-S3c give the 14N flux calibration only implicitly
quality_flags.m30_not_extracted_for_S4c: S4c m/z 30 panel has a single tick label ('10'); not calibratable
quality_flags.run_with_ms_artifacts (S4c): O2 (m/z 32) and m/z 34 show square-wave jumps to ~1800 pA and ~8 pA; potential glitch at 12.2 min; plotted steady current only about -0.04 mA cm-2 at -1.0 V vs RHE. Treat the 15N CA run as questionable.
quality_flags.j_lower (S4c): only 4 columns fall on the lower (-5.25/-5.5) axis segment; upper segment calibrated separately from its own ticks
quality_flags.axis_zero_from_label_centre (S4a/S4b j,: zero tick hidden; label centre used
quality_flags.jpeg_artifacts: JPEG ringing lowers stroke saturation in places; split_stroke flags mark gaps in steep segments

derived_checks.note: DERIVED: median over the last 0.9 min of each pulse. m/z 30 is ~0.3-0.37 of m/z 31 and ~3-4x m/z 46; 15N2O fragmentation to 15N2+ (about 0.1 of m/z 46 by NIST N2O m/z 28/44) explains only a few percent of m/z 30. See README.
